summary: Get main information about a user
description: Retrieves the primary information for a Jamendo user. This endpoint is a lookup (not a search) and requires a client_id together with at least one of id, access_token, or name to identify the user.

parameters.name: client_id
parameters.description: A Client Id provided by devportal.jamendo.com.

parameters.name: callback
parameters.description: Wraps the JSON response in a callback function (JSONP). Only works with json format and GET requests.

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: The position to start returning results from.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of results to return (default 10, max 200). Using 'all' still caps at 200.

parameters.name: order
parameters.description: Sort results by field(s). Append _asc or _desc to specify direction (default ascending).

parameters.name: fullcount
parameters.description: If true, includes 'results_fullcount' in the header indicating total rows without pagination. Use sparingly for performance reasons.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: One or more user IDs (no access token required).

parameters.name: access_token
parameters.description: OAuth2 access token for the Jamendo user whose data you want to retrieve.

parameters.name: imagesize
parameters.description: User avatar size in pixels. If omitted, a default size is returned.

notes: client_id is mandatory for every request.
At least one of id, access_token, or name must be supplied to identify the user.
authType is apikey because the endpoint can be accessed with a client_id; OAuth2 token is optional and used only when access_token is provided.
The 'order' parameter expects a comma‑separated list of fields, each optionally suffixed with _asc or _desc.
